content: {"like":["Enjoys tightly paced, original-flowing dramas like *Amadeus*","Prefers black comedies and offbeat films such as *Killer Joe*","Values strong ensemble performances, especially in character-driven pieces like *Filth*","Appreciates humor in animal-centric animations, e.g., *Penguins of Madagascar*","Seeks complete, uncut theatrical releases without missing content, as with *Les Misérables*"],"dislike":["Dislikes pacing disruptions from added scenes, e.g., in *Amadeus*","Avoids films requiring mid‑film disc changes, like *Amadeus*","Rejects low-quality image and fine‑line artifacts, as in *Amadeus*","Prefers not to watch content with outdated or uninformative material, e.g., *Orwell Rolls in His Grave*","Dislikes poor DVD quality that hampers viewing, such as in *Orwell Rolls in His Grave*"]}
